name: dogfood-observability-iac-drift-app
description: Dogfood app v1.42-2 — a Terraform + OPA + drift detection + cost attribution IaC observability harness driven behind a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa-test/observability v2.2 advanced III semantics (IaC axis: capturePlan + detectDrift + evaluatePolicy + attributeCost) + real-driver env-gate. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same 15-op contract: makeMockAdapter walks the observability v2.2 IaC state machine deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter emits `terraform plan` + OPA `eval` + cost API requests through the KIWA_MODE=real testcontainers-driven stack when KIWA_TERRAFORM_STATE_URL / KIWA_OPA_URL / KIWA_COST_API_URL are wired, and otherwise reports KIWA_IAC_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 3 IaC lifecycle stages (plan / drift / policy / cost) × 4 observability targets (grafana-oss / prometheus / loki / otel-collector) so behavioural drift between mock semantics and real Terraform + OPA stays observable and feeds the @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/observability -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
